senses.gloss:
वेग वेग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. विज्), agitation,
shaking, shock; impetus, impulse, momentum;
impetuosity, speed, rapidity, quickness, velocity, (वे-
गाद् वेगं गम्, to go from speed to speed, increase
one's speed); haste, rashness, violence; onset;
stream, current; blast, breeze; the flight of an arrow;
any sudden impulse or transition of mind (as from
passion to apathy &c.); energy, activity, force,
power, strength, determination, promptitude; passion,
love; pleasure, delight; external indication of any
internal emotion or sensation (as convulsion, sweat,
&c.); expulsion of the feces, evacuation of the natural
excretions; semen virile; the fruit of a kind of
mango.
—वेग-तस्, ind. with speed, quickly, speedily,
hastily.
—वेग-नाशन, अम्, n. ‘preventing speed
or activity,’ phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.
—वेग-
रोध, अस्, m. obstruction of speed or activity, re-
tardation, check; obstruction of the movement of the
bowels or of the natural excretions.
—वेग-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, possessing velocity or activity, impetuous,
rapid; quick, expeditious; agitated; (आन्), m., N.
of a king; (अती), f., N. of a river; a species of
metre (consisting of three anapests and a long syllable
in the first Pāda, three dactyls and a spondee in the
second Pāda).
—वेगवत्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, speediest,
quickest, very quick or swift.
—वेगवत्-तर, अस्,
आ, अम्, more speedy, quicker, swifter, very quick.
—वेगवत्-ता, f. velocity, swiftness.
—वेग-वाहिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, bearing swiftness, swift.
—वेग-विधारण,
अम्, n. retardation of velocity, obstruction of speed,
stopping, retarding; constipation, &c.
—वेग-सर,
अस्, m. ‘going with speed,’ a mule; [cf. वेसर.]
—वेगाघात (˚ग-आघ्˚), अस्, m. ‘speed-obstruc-
tion,’ the sudden arresting of impetus or velocity,
stop, check; obstruction of the natural excretions.
—वेगानिल (˚ग-अन्˚), अस्, m. breeze or blast caused
by the velocity (of a moving object).

वेगित, अस्, आ, अम्, impelled with speed or velocity,
quickened, expedited, swift.

वेगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having velocity, swift, fleet, im-
petuous, rapid; (ई), m. a courier, express; a hawk;
(इनी), f. a river.
—वेगि-ता, f. or वेगि-त्व, अम्, n.
impetus, velocity, quickness, speed.
—वेगि-हरिण,
अस्, m. an antelope (= श्री-कारी).
